title: I let my dachshund sleep on my bed ONE time
author: christasyd
text: I let my dachshund sleep on my bed ONE time and now he comes to my room every night asking to sleep on my bed (he has his own bed in the living room)
blurb: This little red doxie claimed the bed after one invite and now shows up every night, sprawled on his back like he owns the place. His own bed in the living room is apparently just a suggestion.
